newsitem.title: DUBAI: Saudi Arabia says moving to lure foreign investors.
newsitem.headline: Saudi Arabia says moving to lure foreign investors.

text.p: Oil giant Saudi Arabia is taking measures to encourage foreign investment, the kingdom's crown prince said on Monday.
Crown Prince Abdullah said the measures included steps to provide protection for foreign investment and easing bureaucratic obstacles in the licensing of foreign projects in the kingdom.
The official Saudi Press Agency said he was addressing the weekly cabinet meeting.

Saudi Arabia has said it was reviewing its foreign capital law to introduce more incentives to international investors in a country where most foreign capital is invested in joint ventures with Saudi firms.
Foreign capital can be invested without Saudi participation, but then it does not qualify for a range of incentives, including tax holidays.
Saudi Arabia is the world's largest oil producer and exporter.
